title: slimline-credential-orchestra-and-streamer-compat-bump
author: Evelyn Tran
release_notes: Introduce a compact credential-orchestra API that unifies fallback and prefetch behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs; bump SDK major for ergonomics and tiny surface changes; no breaking changes for typical consumers but see migration notes for custom credential registries.
description: Context and motivation: multiple teams observed duplication and subtle behavioral differences in credential fallback, prefetching and stream resumption across the Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs. This PR extracts a compact 'credential orchestra' abstraction, implements a light-weight streamer compatibility shim, and harmonizes retry/backoff presets. Goal: reduce cognitive load for integrators, improve cross-sdk parity, and make future instrumentation consistent. Summary of changes: 1) Add compact credential-orchestra implementation in each SDK (python/typescript/go) that centralizes: primary/fallback chains, lease prefetch, and soft-ttl heartbeats. 2) Introduce a streamer-compat adapter to normalize pull/push stream semantics across runtime environments and reduce edge cases during reauth. 3) Surface a small public API change: SDKs now export CredOrchestraFactory and StreamerAdapter types; older custom registries still work via an adapter factory (migration notes below). 4) Bump package versions: python 1.18.0 -> 2.0.0-rc1, typescript 1.17.2 -> 2.0.0-rc1, go v1.17.2 -> v2.0.0-rc1. 5) Add end-to-end integration tests and updated docs. Checklist: [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-1209 and included rationale; [x] unit + integration tests for py/ts/go; [x] compatibility adapter for legacy registries; [x] CI green after rerun; [x] release notes drafted. Migration notes: Consumers using the default SDK behavior require no changes. Consumers who registered custom credential registries must instantiate the provided adapter: CredRegistryAdapter.wrap(oldRegistry) or follow the one-line factory shim. Backwards compatibility: adapters preserve the old synchronous lookup API while providing async lease semantics under-the-hood. Performance/regression notes: small CPU overhead due to lease heartbeats measured at ~2-4% in high-connection scenarios; added opt-out flag for heartbeat in advanced configs. Tests and validation: added cross-language integration test harness that spins a minimal local loopback server exercising auth refresh, backoff and stream reconnect. Related work: builds on ENG-1155 (retry preset unification) and PM-443 (streaming ergonomics).
commits: init: add cred-orchestra spec and python implementation; ts: implement orchestra + streamer adapter; go: implement lightweight orchestra and tests; docs: upgrade guide and API surface; tests: add e2e auth/stream fixtures; ci: pin versions and bump matrix; fix: address race in Go orchestra heartbeat; chore: bump versions to rc and update changelogs
